title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: In 2025, GOAL’s Programme Innovation Lab supported country teams to deliver stronger impact amid shrinking humanitarian budgets, shifting from generating “new ideas” to helping programmes adopt evidence‑informed, scalable solutions aligned with GOAL’s Crisis to Resilience framework. A key achievement was the continued growth of the Humanitarian Innovation Fund, which reached €270,000 and enabled investment in high‑impact digital and system‑strengthening innovations. Several initiatives advanced from concept to practical use: in Ethiopia, Zcalc and the MOYO chart simplified malnutrition screening for low‑connectivity settings; in Niger, a community-based digital early‑warning and response system reached 158,890 people across 107 communities; and in Sierra Leone, ANCHOR—an AI‑enabled platform integrating WhatsApp reporting—supported Mpox response and is poised for wider replication. Across all contexts, the Lab reinforced a central lesson: innovations scale successfully when designed for low‑resource realities, aligned early with national systems and strengthened through trusted technical partnerships.. A significant number of initiatives supported by the programme innovation lab are focused on developing and fostering innovations that will enhance resilience at community and systems level including to extreme weather events and climate change – including climate smart practices for food and nutrition security for food production, harvesting and processing and improved natural resource management. There will also be significant focus on developing innovations to enhance capacities to adapt to climate change through, improved disaster preparedness, early warning and response and early recovery. This will include support to agroecological practices and on how market systems development can promote climate adaptation for food production and sustainable livelihoods.
